book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Yesu wong moux wei mema bezomb eno ti wo nimzalek bouk wei Sabat o
De Yesu la eivek xomek qekueing ama no, me moux wei mema bezomb eno ti toundei inyon.
Xel on valu di yimexe qayeeng qes wei xel embei byex qayeeng lek Yesu yo, om xel di yei e teyei teyei bei tyek e bong tambiy on bo nimzalek Sabat.
Yesu neil wou moux wei mema bezomb on bei, “Nale ghey nanghei mya nei wou xel dalus ne mend.”
Woyom Yesu teling xel, “Beip inye petieing neil en Sabat bei: wongeing nimza o wongeing nilul, vineing xomaxoneing na toumendei mapieing o leiseing e mey?” Ekom xel dei kanzek.
Moxo yei e vivekwou xel is lalei vanei, me lalei wo maying is en xel laleind on wo nikanzekta, om moxo neil wou moux on, “Tatei memam wo bombek.” Moxo tatei mema, dom mema wo nimzalek.
Lutika eno xel Parisi la myayaing me yimexe sakwaing is Herot xe xel valu bei tyek xel nyeis Yesu na mey ambei nya.
Xomaxoneing qendu ngandoung betiwou Yesu
Yesu is e xe xel betiyeing vup xow veil xel me la ingwei lounyeing nei, me xomaxoneing ngenong lam anghei Galili eno betiy xel.
Xel ngo lul dalus wei e di wong on, om xomaxoneing ngenong lam wou e nanghei Yudia, Yerusalem, Idumia me tembuing danghei wei sekla Yorodan me vivek la pu wei Taia me Saidon nei.
En nambei xel qendu ngandoung on lam om Yesu neil wou e xe xel betiyeing bei xel gyeiwou bot nayak ti wou e boy, en kandek xel xomaxoneing on ti se tendu ma nam paviy e.
En e wong xomaxoneing ngenong wo nimzalek, om eti yeiw wei lam is vanei nilul eno tendu ma lam bei daxlek e.
Xel laweeng nilaxes yei e, xel mi ev vaxend qatu eivek wou e me taxe bei, “Wang on Anutu Neu Moux.”
Ekom Yesu peti xel nikanzek bei xel se neil e teyeimbei e eti.
Yesu beyal sinale xoumeeng yuw
Yesu la pu wei lukendu nei me taxe la wou xel eti yeiw wei e wounalei en o, me xel lam wou e.
E beyal xel xoumeeng yuw me wong lei sinale wou xel, en kandek xel a mi mendei is e me e mi bong xel na myayaing nei me na neil xoulek,
me wong nikanzek wou xel bei xel a mi tiy xel memo.
Inye xel xoumeeng yuw wei e beyal o, Simon, tiwei e taxe e lei nge bei Petele.
Sebedi neu moux Jems me e li Yoan (wei e taxe xel leind bei Boaneges, qes ambei nye bei dewek neuyeiw moux),
Andrias, Pilip, Batolomiu, Matai, Tomas, Alpias neu moux Jems, Tadius, Simon wei Selot wei mi wo vevek en xel xe seyap o
me Yudas Iskariot, tiwei tyek na neil Yesu teyei me na toung e na eivek xel memend o.
Yesu de Belsebul
Woyom Yesu la eivek xomek ti, me xel ngenong qekuma no, omek e is e xe xel betiyeing se teyeimbei gya xend yaeing.
Gyeik e tamali ngo qayeeng en tine eno xel la bei na qou e, en xel neil embei, “Moxo mav o.”
Me xel putoung wei petieing o me eti yeiw wei lep me lam anghei Yerusalem eno neil, “Yesu moxo eno Belsebul gyovaxa wei memo eno dei eivek e, om mi tiy memo la myayaing nangya e xe nikanzek.”
Om Yesu taxe xel me luk wou xel eivek qayeeng pakeing: “Nambei nya Sandang teyeimbei tiy Sandang na myayaing?
Wangwei tete lalei ti venaxow dembu xow na yuw, tete lalei tiyon se teyeimbei bale nikanzek.
Wangwei xomek ti venaxow dembu xow na yuw, xomek tiyon se teyeimbei bale nikanzek.
Me wangwei Sandang bo vevek me dembu venaxow na yuw, e maxow se teyeimbei bale nikanzek, en tyek ma na ma.
Ekom xelti se teyeimbei na eivek tambiy wei nikanzek eno beeng me na qou e xe lulul dalus veil e beeng. Qe ka e tup tambiy on natax bole, woyom na qou lulul eivek e xe xomek lalei.
A neil wou xam zonghek, sewokeing dalus me lukeingyak wei xomaxoneing eno tyek Anutu semaleeng veil xel.
Ekom wangwei eti yeiw baluk yak lek Laweeng Vambuing, tyek e xe nilul on Anutu se teyeimbei semaleeng veil, ma, nimaying wei e xe sewokeing on tyek na mi gyeip luta luta.”
Moxo neil tine en nambei xel di neil embei, “E yon laweeng nilaxes toundei eivek.”
Yesu ta me liyeiw moux
Woyom Yesu ta me liyeiw moux lam tyip me nale myayaing de wong xelti la lalei me taxe e.
De xel qendu ngandoung ti toundei vivekwou e. Om xel neil wou e, “Tam alis limyeiw moux toungale myayaing en embei gyei wang.”
Ekom neil elox, “Inyon a tang me a lingyeiw moux on eti?”
Woyom yei xel wei toundei vivekwou e yon me neil, “Wei! Xel ne a tang me a lingyeiw moux!
Eti yeiw wei mi wong ambei Anutu lalei vind o, yond inye a ling moux me a ling vex me a tang.”
